enforce-lease.mechanism: ADAPTED/PARTIAL generated Pi tool_call gate: structured write/edit targets and supported literal shell redirection/tee targets are project-normalized, checked through existing symlink components, matched against the active role's start-anchored write_scope, and hard-blocked before execution when off-scope. Empty-scope roles, malformed supported targets, absolute/traversal escapes, and symlink escapes fail closed. This is not comprehensive shell-write enforcement: touch, cp, mv, install, sed -i, interpreters, build tools, shell expansion, and other unsupported command forms are not extracted and must not be claimed as lease-gated.

block-dangerous.mechanism: Bounded native Pi tool_call gate: bash commands matching the declared dangerous-command regex corpus are hard-blocked before execution, while tested benign controls are allowed. This claim covers those literal matcher forms only; it does not claim sound arbitrary-shell parsing, quote concatenation, expansion, or command normalization.

protect-sensitive.mechanism: Bounded native Pi tool_call gate: declared sensitive structured path fields and ordinary literal shell tokens such as cat .env, cat .npmrc, and .ssh/config are hard-blocked before execution. Missing built-in path inputs, malformed shell quoting/substitution, non-string bash commands, and token overflow fail closed. Unknown custom tool schemas are explicitly outside this claim; the tokenizer does not expand variables or claim sound arbitrary-shell interpretation.

format.mechanism: .pi/SYSTEM.md + per-role prompt instruction block only, clearly labelled "ADVISORY — NOT ENFORCED ON PI (instruction only)": Pi's on("tool_call") gate blocks but does not run post-edit formatters, and the IR carries no per-language formatter command, so formatting is NOT enforced. The agent is instructed to format edited files. Making this native needs IR-enrichment (per-language formatter command) deferred this cycle.

typecheck.mechanism: .pi/SYSTEM.md + per-role prompt instruction block only, clearly labelled "ADVISORY — NOT ENFORCED ON PI (instruction only)": Pi has no post-edit type-check hook the compiler can wire deterministically, and the IR carries no per-language checker command, so type-checking is NOT enforced. The agent is instructed to type-check edited files. Making this native needs IR-enrichment deferred this cycle.

budget.mechanism: ADVISORY only: agent_end emits a reminder to include files touched and lines added/removed in the completion summary. It computes no report, appends no model-visible result, and is not gated.
